scope: Bind the selected GNU compiler driver's built-in specs output in controlled semantic-adapter build identities without promoting the effective compile contract.

capture.representation: raw stdout bytes; receipt stores byte count and SHA-256 only
capture.recheck: Re-query and compare the typed profile immediately before and after the controlled generator build.
capture.externalSpecsFile: Remains separately captured by the existing GCC -print-file-name=specs file identity when the driver reports an absolute file path.

receiptCompatibility.newProfile: Typed status/method/compilerId/byteCount/digest/reason object validated by the v2 runner and included in exact target/standalone profile parity.
receiptCompatibility.historicalShapes: Pre-tool-binary and pre-built-in-spec CMake identity key sets remain accepted.
unavailableCases: query failure or diagnostic output on stderr
output over the 16 MiB capture limit

validation.builderSelfTest: passed; includes synthetic GNU raw-byte capture/recheck controls and fresh controlled target/standalone build validation
validation.runnerSelfTest: passed; includes profile schema, malformed-profile, legacy-shape, and target/standalone mismatch controls
validation.diffCheck: passed for the two tooling files and plan

limitations: This captures built-in specs output but does not traverse files referenced by GCC specs %include directives.
It does not bind every compiler subprocess, system linker/runtime input, SDK/sysroot content, or native GNU/MSVC environment.
The host routes /usr/bin/gcc and /usr/bin/g++ to AppleClang; no native GCC execution or qualification occurred.
The semantic-adapter compile contract remains advisory; no paired qualification receipt was generated.
nextGate: Add bounded, evidence-backed closure for remaining compiler configuration and link/runtime inputs, then qualify native compiler routes where available. Keep the effective contract partial and paired receipts ineligible until every admitted input is bound.
